article.story: LYNCHBURG, Va. -- — Cooper Campbell had 21 points in Liberty's 113-54 victory against Boyce on Saturday. Campbell added six assists and three steals for the Flames (1-1). Cobi Campbell scored 18 points on 7 of 11 shooting (3 for 7 from 3-point range), and Eli Sancomb went 6 of 10 from the field to finish with 14 points. Boston Boike led the Bulldogs in scoring, finishing with 17 points. Andrew Thomas added nine points, 10 rebounds and two blocks, and Josh Sangalli had nine points. Liberty took the lead with 19:46 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Zander Carter led the Flames in scoring with 11 points in the first half to help put them up 51-19 at the break. Liberty extended its lead to 88-45 during the second half, fueled by an 8-0 scoring run. Cobi Campbell scored a team-high 12 points in the second half as their team closed out the win. Up next Liberty hosts North Carolina Central on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
